# Dana Reyes: engineering profile (a fictional person for tests)

Dana Reyes is a backend and machine-learning engineer based in Lisbon with six years in production systems.

## Work history

- 2019-2022: Backend engineer at Northwind Freight. Built the payment and invoicing services for a freight marketplace.
- 2022-now: Machine-learning engineer at Larkspur Health. Owns the claims-triage model and its serving stack.

## Projects

### Harbor Ledger
Harbor Ledger is a payments reconciliation service that Dana designed and led at Northwind Freight. It processed about 41,000 payments a month and cut the month-end close from 6 days to 2 days. Stack: Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka.

### Trailhead
Trailhead is a hiking route recommendation app Dana built on her own time. It reached 12,000 monthly users. Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostGIS.

## How Dana works

Dana likes small services that do one job well. She says what she tested and what she did not test. When a number is uncertain she says so.

## Incident story

In March 2021 a nightly job at Northwind Freight posted 300 payments twice. Dana found the missing idempotency key within one hour, wrote a replay-safe fix the same day, and added a reconciliation check that has caught every duplicate since.

## What Dana is looking for

Dana is looking for a senior machine-learning engineer role in Lisbon or remote in Europe, available from January 2027.
